description: HTTP middleware clears per-request state, reports thrown route errors, forwards them to later error handlers, and leaves successful routes unreported.

cases.expected_output:
route=/user
status=200
body={"name":"john"}
notify_count=0
notified_message=none
next_error_handler_count=0
clear_count=0

route=/
status=500
body=internal_error_response
notify_count=1
notified_message=Badgers!
next_error_handler_count=1
clear_count=1

route=/
status=200
body=Hello World!
notify_count=0
notified_message=none
next_error_handler_count=0
clear_count=1
